brief: failure-linked candidate detector와 독립 GraphRule SPI를 기반으로 결정적이고 실패 격리된 Rule Engine을 구현한다.

goals.title: Branch outcome 선행 수정
goals.objective: nested condition outcome이 상위 condition에 직접 연결되지 않게 Fact visitor를 수정한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: nested throw regression proves only the nested condition owns THEN_OUTCOME.

goals.title: Evidence-aware candidate identity
goals.objective: 동일 predicate와 Rule의 서로 다른 Evidence 후보에 distinct ID를 제공한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: compatibility overload retained; evidence fingerprint overload and 500-try property pass.

goals.title: Rule domain과 SPI 구현
goals.objective: scope, detector, policy, GraphRule, pack, precedence, engine result와 report 모델을 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: compileJava completed for immutable rule domain and SPI.

goals.title: Conservative detector 구현
goals.objective: throw 기본 탐지, return policy 확장과 method scope 검증을 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: 5 detector examples cover throw, return exclusion, partial policy, invalid scope, two validations and policy failure reporting.

goals.title: Registry와 invocation 격리 구현
goals.objective: immutable rule registry와 exception/null/invalid result 경계를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: duplicate rule IDs are rejected; exceptions and null results are isolated and reported.

goals.title: Dedup, conflict와 fallback 구현
goals.objective: Evidence exact dedup, ambiguity, precedence와 unresolved fallback을 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: duplicates removed, both conflicting candidates retained, lower precedence annotated and unmatched predicates preserved.

goals.title: Default engine과 report 구현
goals.objective: detect-match pipeline과 trace-derived execution report를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: engine examples and report properties validate orchestration and counters.

goals.title: Example-based tests 구현
goals.objective: detector, isolation, dedup, conflict, precedence, fallback와 report 사례를 검증한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: 10 new Rule example tests plus 2 upstream regression examples passed.

goals.title: Rule Engine PBT 구현
goals.objective: ordering, dedup multiplicity, failure isolation과 report counter properties를 구현한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: 4 properties executed with 200/300/200/300 tries and recorded seeds.

goals.title: 전체 검증
goals.objective: 관련, upstream, baseline, legacy와 전체 suite 및 scoped diff를 검증한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: full Gradle suite 82 tests across 25 suites, 0 failures/errors/skips; scoped diff check passed; legacy output files unchanged.

goals.title: PBT finite generator 실행 수 보정
goals.objective: exhaustive 조기 종료 property를 randomized mode로 변경해 승인된 최소 tries를 실제 실행한다.
goals.evidence: PASS: dedup 300, isolation 200 and report 300 tries recorded after randomized mode correction.
